If the checks instead expect a different field structure (e.g., a boolean flag or a specific sub-field), update the check schema to align with the commitment object shape the model actually emits. Strengthen the consultation norm or shared_context instruction for A2 to require using the reveal action for PF1 specifically, so that the formal disclosure mechanism is triggered and PF1 appears in justification_fact_ids alongside the other three facts.
